title: Intervention-Certified Amplification: A Validity Gate for $\sigma$-Weighted Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.33882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hybrid post-training often mixes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), using training-side signals to set each sample's balance. Such signals characterize the anchor data and policy, but not whether the emphasized behavior helps in the target task and evaluation setting. This mismatch can reactivate and amplify pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision. We demonstrate this with DIAA (Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification), a per-sample $\sigma$-weighted SFT/RL hybrid. With all literal Python fences removed from its anchor, DIAA emits unexecuted Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) on $29%$ of MATH-500 prompts, three times vanilla GRPO. Paired interventions show $10.6$ percentage points of accuracy recovery when TIR is suppressed and comparable contributions from SFT imitation and $\sigma$-amplification; a student trained on a $0%$-TIR teacher anchor emits it at $45.8%$. translated_title: 干预认证的放大效应：σ加权后训练的有效性门控
translated_abstract: 混合式后训练通常将监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）相结合，利用训练侧信号来设定每个样本的平衡权重。这类信号刻画的是锚点数据与策略本身的特性，而非被强调的行为在目标任务和评估环境中是否真正有益。这种错配可能重新激活并放大预训练行为，即使其字面形式已从监督信号中移除。我们通过 DIAA（双重隐式对抗放大，Dual-Implicit Adversarial Amplification）来展示这一现象，它是一种逐样本σ加权的 SFT/RL 混合方法。在锚点数据中移除所有字面上的 Python 代码围栏后，DIAA 在 MATH-500 的 29% 提示上输出未执行的工具集成推理（TIR），是原始 GRPO 的三倍。成对干预实验表明，抑制 TIR 可带来 10.6 个百分点的准确率恢复，且 SFT 模仿与σ放大做出了相当的贡献；在 0% TIR 教师锚点上训练的学生模型会以 45.8% 的比例输出 TIR。
tldr: 该论文揭示了混合 SFT/RL 后训练中的训练侧信号会重新激活并放大预训练行为（如 DIAA 在移除 Python 围栏后仍以 29% 的比例输出未执行的 TIR），并提出以成对干预实验作为σ加权后训练的有效性门控来认证其正当性。
en_tdlr: Training-side signals in hybrid SFT/RL post-training can reactivate and amplify latent pretrained behavior even after its literal form is removed from supervision, motivating paired interventions as a validity gate for certifying σ-weighted post-training.
